description.text: Jan, Feb, & March 2027 is available!! Must see views from back lanai that you will enjoy daily! Come experience 55+ living in Del Webb Naples with tons of activities in the town of Ave Maria, FL and close to Naples, FL! Full access to Del Webb clubhouse with resort pool, lap pool, steam/sauna, hot tub, virtual golf simulator, pickleball, bocce ball, tennis and golf! Activities director on site with many planned festivities. Join right in! Golf Cart use included with rental after signing waiver. You can drive golf cart into town of Ave Maria for shopping and dining or to the Del Webb clubhouse. This home is 2 bedrooms, 2 bath, plus den. Home has porcelain tile throughout and Impact glass. Screened in back lanai and extended patio gives you some of the best views Del Webb has and is very private! The exposure is East and South from the back lanai. A screened in front porch offers views of grass lands and woods and great for sunsets! Master is King size bed. 2nd bedroom is Queen. All couches have reclining feature. Golf Cart available for use after signing waiver with landlord. Panther Run golf course is available to guests as tee times allow. Come make yourself at home!

description.text: AVAILABLE IMMEDIATELY! Enjoy peaceful waterfront living in this beautifully maintained Cedar floorplan located in the sought-after Avalon Park community of Ave Maria. This unfurnished 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers over 10-foot ceilings, 8-foot interior doors, tile flooring throughout, and a spacious open-concept design filled with natural light. The well-appointed kitchen opens seamlessly to the living and dining areas, creating the perfect space for everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to the screened lanai and fully fenced backyard where you can relax and enjoy tranquil pond views and stunning Florida sunrises. Additional features include a 2-car garage, paver driveway, and low-maintenance living with lawn care included in the rent. Ideally located within walking distance to schools, parks, playgrounds, shopping, dining, and the Ave Maria Town Center. Enjoy everything this golf cart-friendly community has to offer, including miles of walking and biking trails, community events, outdoor recreation, and the unique small-town charm that makes Ave Maria one of Southwest Florida's most desirable places to live. Move-in ready and available now. Schedule your private showing today!
